{{Quote|Your public approval rating has been dropping since the announcement of Niathal's suicide, and Security thinks someone might take a shot at you during the service.|Wynn Dorvan, to Natasi Daala|<ref name="lash" />}}
The '''funeral of Cha Niathal''' took place after [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cha Niathal]]'s [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. Niathal decided to commit suicide rather than face the charges of dereliction of duty raised against her by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]. Niathal's corpse was brought to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for her [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]], but public resentment toward Daala prevented the Chief of State from attending. Several other government and military figures attended the funeral procession, which ran from the [[Mon Calamari Embassy]] to the [[Plaza of the Founders]] near Coruscant's [[Senate District/Legends|political district]]. [[Journalist/Legends|Journalist]] [[Javis Tyrr]] reported live on the funeral for the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], and after the procession concluded at the Plaza of the Founders, former Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] gave the eulogy.

==Prelude==
[[File:Niathal.jpg|thumb|left|125px|Former Galactic Alliance Admiral Cha Niathal]]
{{Quote|This has been done with honor, without error, and by my choosing. Niathal out.|Cha Niathal's suicide note|<ref name="lash" />}}
In a move suggested by [[Chief of Starfighter Command (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of Starfighter Command]] [[Merratt Jaxton]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]&mdash;who was secretly a member of a [[Lecersen Conspiracy|conspiracy]] to overthrow [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]&mdash;Daala planned to bring former Galactic Alliance [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cha Niathal]] to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to stand trial for dereliction of duty during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Daala's motives were [[Politics/Legends|political]]: she hoped to improve her public image by proving that the government was not being particularly unfair in its dealings with the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]].<ref name="lash" />

By putting Niathal on trial, she hoped to show that military officials were receiving the same treatment as [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] had [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Luke Skywalker|received]]&mdash;the Galactic Alliance had previously [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] Skywalker from Coruscant for dereliction of duty for failing to prevent [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]]' fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] during the Civil War. Daala knew that the charges against Niathal were weak and thus believed that she would be easily acquitted. Although Niathal pretended to agree to Daala's terms, the former Admiral decided to avoid the shame of the trial; she committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]] by pumping [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] monoxide into her [[Aquarium/Legends|aquarium]]. Niathal's [[Cha Niathal's assistant|assistant]] found her the following morning upon Alliance [[Diplomat/Legends|emissary]] [[Elyas Caran]]'s arrival, and her death was quickly reported to Daala.<ref name="lash" />

==The funeral==
{{Quote|The drum corps has begun, I believe it's a percussion arrangement of 'Tialga Hath Fallen,' a traditional Aldeeranian air about a warrior-queen who makes a stand against impossible odds so her children can reach safe haven.|Javis Tyrr, narrating the funeral|<ref name="lash" />}}
[[File:NatasiDaalaBacklash.jpg|thumb|right|125px|Chief of State Natasi Daala]]
Daala was shocked and disturbed by Niathal's suicide, and the former Admiral was brought to Coruscant for her [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]], which was signed off by an individual who used the name of [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] "[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Koltstan"&mdash;although a later investigation showed that no "Captain Koltstan" existed in the Secutiry Force. Much of the public blamed Daala for Niathal's death, and several civilians attending the funeral made signs that accused Daala and even called for the Galactic Alliance to pull out of Niathal's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. Daala's [[Aide/Legends|aide]], [[Wynn Dorvan]], also reported to the Chief of State that the Coruscant Security Force believed the threat level against Daala was too high for her to safely attend the funeral, and she reluctantly agreed to watch the procession from inside [[Chief of State's Suite|her office]].<ref name="lash" />

The funeral procession began at the [[Mon Calamari Embassy]] on Coruscant, passed [[Medway Avenue]], and finally arrived at the [[Plaza of the Founders]] near the planet's [[Senate District/Legends|political district]]. Niathal was carried in a casket with a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] top, and the [[Galactic Alliance Navy Drum Corps]], which played a percussion arrangement of the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] air '[[Tialga Hath Fallen]]', rode in barges directly behind her. Following the Drum Corps was a long line of dark [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] housing [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]], [[Officer/Legends|officers]], and other beings who had personally known Niathal. Also in the procession was [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]], whose vehicle was followed by that of the Mon Calamari Embassy. [[Journalist/Legends|Journalist]] [[Javis Tyrr]] narrated the funeral for the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] broadcast, and when the Procession reached the Plaza of the Founders, [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], former [[General/Legends|General]] of [[Galactic Alliance Starfighter Command]], gave the eulogy for Niathal while a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] commending her was played.<ref name="lash" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Eat your vegetables, children, or Admiral Daala will come for you.|Wynn Dorvan, joking with Daala about increasing public resentment toward her |<ref name="lash" />}}
After the funeral, public sentiment toward Daala continued to worsen, but she decided nevertheless to continue with her harsh political methods, particularly in her dealings with the Jedi Order.<ref name="lash" /><ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref> However, Daala was eventually [[Plan Delta|ousted]] from her position of Chief of State.<ref name="Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The funeral of Cha Niathal appeared in [[Aaron Allston]]'s ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'', his second installment and the fourth novel overall in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.
